scenes.title: Into the Event Horizon
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# EVENT HORIZON
# A camera falls through a continuously warped star field toward a rotating
# black hole. No spatial lattice is used anywhere in the image.

function moving star field at x y with scale phase time:
    execute:
        set depth to fractional part of (time * 0.13 + phase)
        set expansion to 0.42 + ((depth * depth) * 3.6)
        set star_x to (x / expansion) * scale
        set star_y to (y / expansion) * scale
        set points to spark field at star_x star_y (phase * 13.7)
        set streak_x to spark field at (star_x * 0.33) star_y (phase * 13.7 + 0.09)
        set streak_y to spark field at star_x (star_y * 0.33) (phase * 13.7 - 0.11)
        set streaks to (streak_x + streak_y) * glow from 0.0 to 1.35 at (the square root of (x * x + y * y))
        set twinkle to (the sine of (time * 2.7 + phase * 29.0)) * 0.13 + 0.87
        return (((points * 2.8) + (streaks * 0.17)) * (0.28 + (depth * 1.25))) * twinkle

set pixel_x to the fragment x coordinate
set pixel_y to the fragment y coordinate
set time to the shader time
set width to the maximum of the shader width and 1.0
set height to the maximum of the shader height and 1.0
set aspect to width / height
set screen_x to (((pixel_x / width) * 2.0) - 1.0) * aspect
set screen_y to ((pixel_y / height) * 2.0) - 1.0

# The fall accelerates and drifts, making the horizon consume the camera.
set flight_scale to (0.62 + (time * 0.055)) + ((time * time) * 0.0018)
set drift_x to (the sine of (time * 0.27)) * 0.048
set drift_y to (the cosine of (time * 0.21)) * 0.026
set x to (screen_x + drift_x) / flight_scale
set y to (screen_y + drift_y) / flight_scale
set radius to the square root of (x * x + y * y)
set safe_radius to the maximum of radius and 0.001

# Gravitational lensing twists and magnifies the universe around the shadow.
set lens_angle to 0.19 / (radius * radius + 0.021) + time * 0.035
set lens_angle to the minimum of lens_angle and 4.6
set lens_sine to the sine of lens_angle
set lens_cosine to the cosine of lens_angle
set lens_scale to 1.0 + 0.12 / (radius * radius + 0.012)
set universe_x to (x * lens_cosine - y * lens_sine) * lens_scale
set universe_y to (x * lens_sine + y * lens_cosine) * lens_scale

# A continuous domain-warped nebula replaces the old square value-noise field.
set cloud_one to flowing field at (universe_x * 1.8 + time * 0.025) (universe_y * 1.8 - 4.0) 1.7
set cloud_two to flowing field at (universe_x * 4.6 - 11.0) (universe_y * 4.6 + time * 0.018) 5.3
set cloud_ridge to ridged field at (universe_x * 2.4 + 7.0) (universe_y * 2.4 - 9.0) (time * 0.045)
set aurora_phase to (universe_x * 2.7 - universe_y * 3.6) + cloud_one * 8.0
set aurora to (the sine of aurora_phase) * 0.5 + 0.5
set cloud_light to smooth transition from 0.45 to 0.86 at cloud_one
set dust_light to smooth transition from 0.52 to 0.90 at cloud_two
set red to (0.002 + (cloud_light * 0.022)) + ((cloud_ridge * aurora) * 0.075)
set green to (0.004 + (cloud_light * 0.028)) + ((dust_light * aurora) * 0.052)
set blue to (0.014 + (cloud_light * 0.13)) + ((dust_light * (1.0 - aurora)) * 0.24)

# Three curved depth strata stream past the lens.
set stars_far to moving star field at universe_x universe_y with 13.0 0.09 time
set stars_mid to moving star field at universe_x universe_y with 21.0 0.41 time
set stars_near to moving star field at universe_x universe_y with 31.0 0.77 time
set stars to ((stars_far * 0.46) + (stars_mid * 0.76)) + (stars_near * 1.14)
set star_color to flowing field at (universe_x * 5.1) (universe_y * 5.1) 8.2
set red to red + stars * (0.58 + star_color * 0.62)
set green to green + stars * (0.70 + star_color * 0.31)
set blue to blue + stars * (1.25 - star_color * 0.18)

# A dense, tilted accretion flow. Continuous curl controls every filament.
set tilt to 0.12 + (the sine of (time * 0.17)) * 0.018
set tilt_sine to the sine of tilt
set tilt_cosine to the cosine of tilt
set disk_x to x * tilt_cosine + y * tilt_sine
set disk_y to y * tilt_cosine - x * tilt_sine
set stretched_y to disk_y * 7.2
set disk_radius to the square root of (disk_x * disk_x + stretched_y * stretched_y)
set disk_inner to smooth transition from 0.23 to 0.285 at disk_radius
set disk_outer to 1.0 - smooth transition from 0.72 to 1.12 at disk_radius
set disk_mask to disk_inner * disk_outer
set turbulence to signed flow at (disk_x * 8.3 + time * 0.52) (stretched_y * 1.8) 3.1
set fine_turbulence to signed flow at (disk_x * 18.0 - time * 0.91) (stretched_y * 3.7) 7.9
set spiral_phase to (((disk_radius * 39.0) - (time * 6.8)) + (turbulence * 7.4)) + (fine_turbulence * 2.2)
set spiral to (the sine of spiral_phase) * 0.5 + 0.5
set braided_phase to ((disk_radius * 71.0) - (time * 10.4)) - (turbulence * 4.0)
set braided to (the cosine of braided_phase) * 0.5 + 0.5
set hot_inner to 1.0 - smooth transition from 0.29 to 0.83 at disk_radius
set disk_energy to (disk_mask * ((0.19 + (spiral * 0.58)) + (braided * 0.23))) * (0.55 + (hot_inner * 4.4))
set approaching to saturate ((disk_x / the maximum of disk_radius and 0.001) * 0.5 + 0.5)
set red to red + disk_energy * (1.72 - approaching * 0.62)
set green to green + disk_energy * (0.30 + approaching * 1.04)
set blue to blue + disk_energy * (0.055 + approaching * 2.18)

# Relativistic jets become visible close to the poles.
set jet_axis to the absolute value of x
set jet_core to glow from 0.0 to 0.032 at jet_axis
set jet_halo to glow from 0.018 to 0.16 at jet_axis
set jet_reach to smooth transition from 0.19 to 0.72 at (the absolute value of y)
set jet_flicker to flowing field at (x * 15.0) (y * 3.0 - time * 0.8) 10.0
set jet to (((jet_core * 0.52) + (jet_halo * 0.13)) * jet_reach) * (0.35 + (jet_flicker * 0.65))
set red to red + jet * 0.21
set green to green + jet * 0.48
set blue to blue + jet * 1.36

# The shadow erases the far universe. The near side of the disk remains.
set horizon to 1.0 - smooth transition from 0.176 to 0.202 at radius
set red to red * (1.0 - horizon)
set green to green * (1.0 - horizon)
set blue to blue * (1.0 - horizon)
set near_side to 1.0 - smooth transition from -0.019 to 0.015 at disk_y
set foreground_disk to disk_energy * near_side
set red to red + foreground_disk * (1.61 - approaching * 0.48)
set green to green + foreground_disk * (0.34 + approaching * 0.93)
set blue to blue + foreground_disk * (0.07 + approaching * 1.94)

# Light wraps around both poles into a sharp photon ring.
set photon_distance to the absolute value of (radius - 0.216)
set photon_ring to glow from 0.001 to 0.017 at photon_distance
set polar_amount to the absolute value of (y / safe_radius)
set polar_arcs to photon_ring * smooth transition from 0.16 to 0.86 at polar_amount
set ring_flicker to (the sine of (time * 2.1 + turbulence * 5.0)) * 0.10 + 0.90
set red to (red + ((photon_ring * 1.34) * ring_flicker)) + (polar_arcs * 2.2)
set green to (green + ((photon_ring * 0.72) * ring_flicker)) + (polar_arcs * 0.93)
set blue to (blue + ((photon_ring * 0.44) * ring_flicker)) + (polar_arcs * 1.48)

# Filmic compression without a raster film: the browser shades every pixel.
set horizon_gap to the absolute value of (radius - 0.202)
set halo to (0.04 / (horizon_gap + 0.04)) * (1.0 - horizon)
set red to red + halo * 0.19
set green to green + halo * 0.07
set blue to blue + halo * 0.31
set vignette_radius to the square root of ((screen_x / aspect) * (screen_x / aspect) + screen_y * screen_y)
set vignette to 0.18 + (1.0 - smooth transition from 0.48 to 1.34 at vignette_radius) * 0.82
set red to the square root of ((red * vignette) / (1.0 + red))
set green to the square root of ((green * vignette) / (1.0 + green))
set blue to the square root of ((blue * vignette) / (1.0 + blue))
set the fragment color to red green blue 1.0

scenes.title: Endless Terrain
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# ENDLESS TERRAIN
# Fixed camera rays and exponentially spaced distance rows form a perspective
# terrain plane. Its crack-free topology is displaced into an alpine height
# field and a coarser water surface without a fragment-stage ray march.

function terrain height at x z:
    execute:
        set continental_fold to simplex field at (x * 0.011) (z * 0.011) 1.7
        set warp_x to simplex field at (x * 0.021 + 9.0) (z * 0.021 - 4.0) 4.1
        set warp_z to simplex field at ((x * -0.006) + (z * 0.019)) ((z * 0.007) + (x * 0.020)) 8.3
        set bent_x to x + warp_x * 9.5
        set bent_z to z + warp_z * 9.5

        set mountain_wave to simplex field at ((bent_x * 0.027) + (bent_z * 0.006)) ((bent_z * 0.027) - (bent_x * 0.006)) 2.3
        set crossing_wave to simplex field at ((bent_x * -0.018) + (bent_z * 0.057)) ((bent_z * 0.019) + (bent_x * 0.054)) 6.9
        set broken_wave to simplex field at ((bent_x * 0.119) + (bent_z * 0.041)) ((bent_z * 0.113) - (bent_x * 0.037)) 9.7
        set folded_mass to ((mountain_wave * 0.60) + (crossing_wave * 0.27)) + (broken_wave * 0.13)
        set mountain_ridge to the maximum of folded_mass and 0.0
        set mountain_ridge to mountain_ridge * mountain_ridge
        set ridge_fold to 1.0 - (the absolute value of ((mountain_wave * 0.78) + (crossing_wave * 0.34)))
        set ridge_crest to the maximum of (ridge_fold - 0.42) and 0.0
        set ridge_crest to ridge_crest * ridge_crest
        set uplift to smooth transition from -0.48 to 0.45 at continental_fold
        set erosion_channels to 1.0 - smooth transition from 0.035 to 0.31 at (the absolute value of (crossing_wave + broken_wave * 0.24))
        set alpine_mass to folded_mass * 1.38
        set alpine_mass to alpine_mass + mountain_ridge * (2.00 + uplift * 6.00)
        set alpine_mass to alpine_mass + (ridge_crest * uplift) * (3.1 + mountain_ridge * 2.4)
        set alpine_mass to alpine_mass + (broken_wave * uplift) * 0.34
        set alpine_mass to alpine_mass - ((erosion_channels * uplift) * (0.16 + mountain_ridge * 0.38))
        set basin to continental_fold * 1.20
        return (basin + alpine_mass) - 0.75

function terrain camera x at moment:
    execute:
        return 201.7 + ((the sine of (moment * 0.091)) * 4.2 + (the cosine of (moment * 0.037)) * 1.6)

function terrain camera z at moment:
    execute:
        return (-92.1) + (moment * 3.25)

# The positive maxima of every bounded field term sum to 12.0202.
function terrain maximum possible height:
    execute:
        return 12.10

function terrain camera altitude:
    execute:
        return (terrain maximum possible height) + 0.70

function water detail visibility at distance:
    execute:
        return 1.0 - (smooth transition from 48.0 to 96.0 at distance)

if this is a vertex shader:
    set time to the shader time
    set width to the maximum of the shader width and 1.0
    set height to the maximum of the shader height and 1.0
    set aspect to width / height
    set surface_vertex to the vertex w

    if surface_vertex < 0.5:
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain_position" to (the vertex x) (the vertex y) 0.0 0.0
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain_normal" to 0.0 1.0 0.0 0.0
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain_material" to 0.5 0.0 0.0 0.0
        set the output position to (the vertex x) (the vertex y) 0.9999 1.0
    else:
        set ray_distance to the vertex y
        set camera_x to terrain camera x at time
        set camera_z to terrain camera z at time
        set camera_y to terrain camera altitude
        set camera_pitch to 0.155
        set pitch_sine to the sine of camera_pitch
        set pitch_cosine to the cosine of camera_pitch
        set yaw to (the sine of (time * 0.073)) * 0.13 + (the cosine of (time * 0.041)) * 0.045
        set yaw_sine to the sine of yaw
        set yaw_cosine to the cosine of yaw

        set base_vertical_distance to 0.0 - camera_y
        set ray_slope to ((the vertex x) * aspect) * 0.80
        set ray_forward_scale to the square root of (1.0 + ((ray_slope * pitch_cosine) * (ray_slope * pitch_cosine)))
        set forward_distance to ray_distance / ray_forward_scale
        set base_view_depth to (forward_distance * pitch_cosine) - (base_vertical_distance * pitch_sine)
        set lateral_distance to ray_slope * base_view_depth
        set world_x to (camera_x + (lateral_distance * yaw_cosine)) + (forward_distance * yaw_sine)
        set world_z to (camera_z + (forward_distance * yaw_cosine)) - (lateral_distance * yaw_sine)

        set displaced_height to 0.0
        set normal_x to 0.0
        set normal_y to 1.0
        set normal_z to 0.0
        set surface_variation to 0.5
        set surface_detail to 0.5
        set water_depth to 0.0
        if surface_vertex > 1.5:
            set water_level to -0.62
            set water_depth to water_level - (terrain height at world_x world_z)
            set water_depth to the maximum of water_depth and 0.0
            set water_angle_x to (world_x * 0.17) + (world_z * 0.07) + (time * 0.41)
            set water_angle_z to (world_z * 0.21) - (world_x * 0.05) - (time * 0.32)
            set water_angle_cross to (world_x * 0.09) + (world_z * 0.13) + (time * 0.23)
            set water_wave_x to the sine of water_angle_x
            set water_wave_z to the sine of water_angle_z
            set water_wave_cross to the sine of water_angle_cross
            set water_cosine_x to the cosine of water_angle_x
            set water_cosine_z to the cosine of water_angle_z
            set water_cosine_cross to the cosine of water_angle_cross
            set water_geometry_visibility to water detail visibility at ray_distance
            set water_displacement to (((water_wave_x * 0.045) + (water_wave_z * 0.028)) + (water_wave_cross * 0.018)) * water_geometry_visibility
            set displaced_height to water_level + water_displacement
            set normal_x to (0.0 - (((water_cosine_x * 0.00765) - (water_cosine_z * 0.00140)) + (water_cosine_cross * 0.00162))) * water_geometry_visibility
            set normal_z to (0.0 - (((water_cosine_x * 0.00315) + (water_cosine_z * 0.00588)) + (water_cosine_cross * 0.00234))) * water_geometry_visibility
            set surface_variation to 0.5 + (((water_wave_x + water_wave_z) * 0.25) * water_geometry_visibility)
            set surface_detail to 0.5 + ((water_wave_cross * 0.5) * water_geometry_visibility)
        else:
            set normal_step to 0.34
            set displaced_height to terrain height at world_x world_z
            set height_left to terrain height at (world_x - normal_step) world_z
            set height_right to terrain height at (world_x + normal_step) world_z
            set height_back to terrain height at world_x (world_z - normal_step)
            set height_front to terrain height at world_x (world_z + normal_step)
            set normal_x to height_left - height_right
            set normal_y to normal_step * 2.0
            set normal_z to height_back - height_front
            set surface_variation to (simplex field at (world_x * 0.065) (world_z * 0.065) 13.7) * 0.5 + 0.5
            set surface_detail to (simplex field at (world_x * 0.14) (world_z * 0.14) 16.2) * 0.5 + 0.5

        set normal_length to the square root of (((normal_x * normal_x) + (normal_y * normal_y)) + (normal_z * normal_z))
        set normal_x to normal_x / normal_length
        set normal_y to normal_y / normal_length
        set normal_z to normal_z / normal_length

        set vertical_distance to displaced_height - camera_y
        set view_y to vertical_distance * pitch_cosine + forward_distance * pitch_sine
        set view_z to forward_distance * pitch_cosine - vertical_distance * pitch_sine
        set clip_x to lateral_distance / (aspect * 0.72)
        set clip_y to view_y / 0.72
        set clip_z to view_z * 1.00078 - 0.40016

        set the shader interpolant named "terrain_position" to world_x displaced_height world_z surface_vertex
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain_normal" to normal_x normal_y normal_z ray_distance
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain_material" to surface_variation surface_detail water_depth 0.0
        set the output position to clip_x clip_y clip_z view_z

if this is a fragment shader:
    set pixel_x to the fragment x coordinate
    set pixel_y to the fragment y coordinate
    set time to the shader time
    set width to the maximum of the shader width and 1.0
    set height to the maximum of the shader height and 1.0
    set aspect to width / height
    set screen_x to (((pixel_x / width) * 2.0) - 1.0) * aspect
    set screen_y to ((pixel_y / height) * 2.0) - 1.0

    set world_x to the shader interpolant x named "terrain_position"
    set world_y to the shader interpolant y named "terrain_position"
    set world_z to the shader interpolant z named "terrain_position"
    set surface_kind to the shader interpolant w named "terrain_position"
    set normal_x to the shader interpolant x named "terrain_normal"
    set normal_y to the shader interpolant y named "terrain_normal"
    set normal_z to the shader interpolant z named "terrain_normal"
    set ray_distance to the shader interpolant w named "terrain_normal"
    set surface_variation to the shader interpolant x named "terrain_material"
    set surface_detail to the shader interpolant y named "terrain_material"
    set water_depth to the shader interpolant z named "terrain_material"

    set sun_x to screen_x - 0.52
    set sun_y to screen_y - 0.36
    set sun_distance to the square root of (sun_x * sun_x + sun_y * sun_y)
    set sun_core to glow from 0.014 to 0.065 at sun_distance
    set sun_halo to glow from 0.04 to 0.44 at sun_distance
    set red to 0.025
    set green to 0.064
    set blue to 0.13

    if surface_kind < 0.5:
        set sky_height to saturate (screen_y * 0.48 + 0.43)
        set red to 0.022 + sky_height * 0.105
        set green to 0.061 + sky_height * 0.18
        set blue to 0.14 + sky_height * 0.33
        set cloud_fold to (the sine of (screen_x * 1.21 + screen_y * 1.77 + time * 0.021)) * 0.5 + 0.5
        set cloud_crossing to (the cosine of (screen_x * -0.67 + screen_y * 2.93 - time * 0.016)) * 0.5 + 0.5
        set cloud_detail to (the sine of (screen_x * 2.47 - screen_y * 4.11 + cloud_fold * 1.8)) * 0.5 + 0.5
        set cloud_shape to smooth transition from 1.42 to 2.18 at ((cloud_fold + cloud_crossing) + (cloud_detail * 0.46))
        set cloud_altitude to smooth transition from -0.08 to 0.38 at screen_y
        set cloud_light to cloud_shape * cloud_altitude
        set red to red + cloud_light * 0.33
        set green to green + cloud_light * 0.31
        set blue to blue + cloud_light * 0.29
        set red to (red + (sun_halo * 0.31)) + (sun_core * 1.36)
        set green to (green + (sun_halo * 0.19)) + (sun_core * 0.96)
        set blue to (blue + (sun_halo * 0.09)) + (sun_core * 0.55)
    else:
        set normal_length to the square root of (((normal_x * normal_x) + (normal_y * normal_y)) + (normal_z * normal_z))
        set normal_x to normal_x / normal_length
        set normal_y to normal_y / normal_length
        set normal_z to normal_z / normal_length
        set sunlight to saturate (((normal_x * -0.43) + (normal_y * 0.79)) + (normal_z * -0.44))
        set sky_fill to saturate (normal_y * 0.56 + 0.44)

        if surface_kind > 1.5:
            # Fine analytic ripples perturb the interpolated geometric waves.
            set ripple_angle_one to (world_x * 1.37) + (world_z * 0.91) + (time * 1.12)
            set ripple_angle_two to (world_x * -0.83) + (world_z * 1.61) - (time * 0.94)
            set ripple_angle_three to (world_x * 2.11) - (world_z * 0.57) + (time * 0.71)
            set ripple_cosine_one to the cosine of ripple_angle_one
            set ripple_cosine_two to the cosine of ripple_angle_two
            set ripple_cosine_three to the cosine of ripple_angle_three
            set water_ripple_visibility to water detail visibility at ray_distance
            set ripple_normal_x to (((ripple_cosine_one * 0.07095) - (ripple_cosine_two * 0.02835)) + (ripple_cosine_three * 0.03195)) * water_ripple_visibility
            set ripple_normal_z to (((ripple_cosine_one * 0.05115) + (ripple_cosine_two * 0.05355)) - (ripple_cosine_three * 0.00855)) * water_ripple_visibility
            set normal_x to normal_x - ripple_normal_x
            set normal_z to normal_z - ripple_normal_z
            set water_normal_length to the square root of (((normal_x * normal_x) + (normal_y * normal_y)) + (normal_z * normal_z))
            set normal_x to normal_x / water_normal_length
            set normal_y to normal_y / water_normal_length
            set normal_z to normal_z / water_normal_length

            # A fixed-altitude camera supplies the per-pixel view vector.
            set camera_x to terrain camera x at time
            set camera_y to terrain camera altitude
            set camera_z to terrain camera z at time
            set water_view_x to camera_x - world_x
            set water_view_y to camera_y - world_y
            set water_view_z to camera_z - world_z
            set water_view_length to the square root of (((water_view_x * water_view_x) + (water_view_y * water_view_y)) + (water_view_z * water_view_z))
            set water_view_x to water_view_x / water_view_length
            set water_view_y to water_view_y / water_view_length
            set water_view_z to water_view_z / water_view_length
            set water_view_facing to saturate (((normal_x * water_view_x) + (normal_y * water_view_y)) + (normal_z * water_view_z))

            # Schlick Fresnel keeps the body colored while grazing angles reflect sky.
            set fresnel_grazing to 1.0 - water_view_facing
            set fresnel_squared to fresnel_grazing * fresnel_grazing
            set fresnel_fourth to fresnel_squared * fresnel_squared
            set water_fresnel to 0.020 + (fresnel_fourth * fresnel_grazing) * 0.980
            set reflected_x to (normal_x * water_view_facing * 2.0) - water_view_x
            set reflected_y to (normal_y * water_view_facing * 2.0) - water_view_y
            set reflected_z to (normal_z * water_view_facing * 2.0) - water_view_z
            set reflected_sky_height to saturate (reflected_y * 0.72 + 0.28)
            set reflection_red to 0.16 * (1.0 - reflected_sky_height) + 0.025 * reflected_sky_height
            set reflection_green to 0.24 * (1.0 - reflected_sky_height) + 0.095 * reflected_sky_height
            set reflection_blue to 0.32 * (1.0 - reflected_sky_height) + 0.24 * reflected_sky_height
            set reflected_cloud_one to (the sine of (((reflected_x * 2.1) + (reflected_z * 1.3)) + (time * 0.018))) * 0.5 + 0.5
            set reflected_cloud_two to (the cosine of (((reflected_x * -1.4) + (reflected_z * 2.7)) - (time * 0.013))) * 0.5 + 0.5
            set reflected_cloud to smooth transition from 1.25 to 1.72 at (reflected_cloud_one + reflected_cloud_two)
            set reflection_red to reflection_red + reflected_cloud * 0.028
            set reflection_green to reflection_green + reflected_cloud * 0.036
            set reflection_blue to reflection_blue + reflected_cloud * 0.045

            # The reflected view ray meets the visible sun direction, producing
            # a broken highlight path instead of tinting the whole lake.
            set reflected_sun_alignment to saturate (((reflected_x * 0.39) + (reflected_y * 0.32)) + (reflected_z * 0.86))
            set water_sun_glint to reflected_sun_alignment
            set water_sun_glint to water_sun_glint * water_sun_glint
            set water_sun_glint to water_sun_glint * water_sun_glint
            set water_sun_glint to water_sun_glint * water_sun_glint
            set water_sun_glint to water_sun_glint * water_sun_glint
            set water_sun_glint to water_sun_glint * water_sun_glint
            set water_sun_glow to water_sun_glint
            set water_sun_glint to water_sun_glint * water_sun_glint
            set water_sun_glint to water_sun_glint * (0.35 + water_fresnel * 0.65)

            # Interpolated lake depth exposes turquoise shallows without a
            # terrain evaluation in every fragment.
            set shallow_water to (1.0 - (smooth transition from 0.18 to 3.8 at water_depth)) * water_ripple_visibility
            set water_absorption to smooth transition from 24.0 to 220.0 at ray_distance
            set water_body_red to (0.004 + surface_variation * 0.008) * (1.0 - water_absorption * 0.42)
            set water_body_green to (0.018 + surface_variation * 0.038) * (1.0 - water_absorption * 0.28)
            set water_body_blue to (0.042 + surface_variation * 0.058) * (1.0 - water_absorption * 0.12)
            set water_body_red to water_body_red * (1.0 - shallow_water) + (0.018 + surface_detail * 0.012) * shallow_water
            set water_body_green to water_body_green * (1.0 - shallow_water) + (0.105 + surface_detail * 0.050) * shallow_water
            set water_body_blue to water_body_blue * (1.0 - shallow_water) + (0.125 + surface_detail * 0.055) * shallow_water
            set water_caustic_depth to (1.0 - (smooth transition from 0.05 to 0.65 at water_depth)) * water_ripple_visibility
            set water_caustic_distance to the absolute value of ((ripple_cosine_one + (ripple_cosine_two * 0.72)) + (ripple_cosine_three * 0.28))
            set water_caustic to (glow from 0.0 to 0.18 at water_caustic_distance) * water_caustic_depth
            set water_body_red to water_body_red + water_caustic * 0.006
            set water_body_green to water_body_green + water_caustic * 0.032
            set water_body_blue to water_body_blue + water_caustic * 0.040
            set water_red to water_body_red * (1.0 - water_fresnel) + reflection_red * water_fresnel
            set water_green to water_body_green * (1.0 - water_fresnel) + reflection_green * water_fresnel
            set water_blue to water_body_blue * (1.0 - water_fresnel) + reflection_blue * water_fresnel
            set water_red to water_red + water_sun_glow * 0.080
            set water_green to water_green + water_sun_glow * 0.045
            set water_blue to water_blue + water_sun_glow * 0.018
            set water_red to water_red + water_sun_glint * 0.70
            set water_green to water_green + water_sun_glint * 0.42
            set water_blue to water_blue + water_sun_glint * 0.16
            set water_fog to smooth transition from 232.0 to 376.0 at ray_distance
            set red to water_red * (1.0 - water_fog) + 0.17 * water_fog
            set green to water_green * (1.0 - water_fog) + 0.23 * water_fog
            set blue to water_blue * (1.0 - water_fog) + 0.31 * water_fog
        else:
            set slope to 1.0 - normal_y
            set material_variation to (surface_variation * 0.68) + (surface_detail * 0.32)
            set fracture to saturate ((surface_detail - 0.32) * 1.35 + slope * 1.7)
            set exposed_rock to smooth transition from 0.055 to 0.30 at (slope + ((fracture - 0.5) * 0.095))
            set snow to smooth transition from 2.75 to 4.45 at (world_y + ((material_variation - 0.5) * 0.48))
            set snow to snow * smooth transition from 0.25 to 0.66 at normal_y
            set snow to snow * (0.88 + surface_detail * 0.12)
            set alpine_zone to smooth transition from 0.35 to 2.65 at world_y
            set rock_warmth to saturate (((normal_x * 0.38) - (normal_z * 0.26)) + 0.48)

            set meadow_red to (0.028 + material_variation * 0.050) + alpine_zone * 0.034
            set meadow_green to (0.094 + material_variation * 0.086) - alpine_zone * 0.050
            set meadow_blue to (0.043 + material_variation * 0.036) + alpine_zone * 0.020
            set rock_red to (0.119 + material_variation * 0.066) + rock_warmth * 0.074
            set rock_green to (0.112 + material_variation * 0.058) + rock_warmth * 0.047
            set rock_blue to (0.118 + material_variation * 0.054) + rock_warmth * 0.037
            set ground_red to meadow_red * (1.0 - exposed_rock) + rock_red * exposed_rock
            set ground_green to meadow_green * (1.0 - exposed_rock) + rock_green * exposed_rock
            set ground_blue to meadow_blue * (1.0 - exposed_rock) + rock_blue * exposed_rock
            set ground_red to ground_red * (1.0 - snow) + 0.78 * snow
            set ground_green to ground_green * (1.0 - snow) + 0.83 * snow
            set ground_blue to ground_blue * (1.0 - snow) + 0.87 * snow

            set material_light to 0.80 + surface_detail * 0.26
            set lighting to ((0.17 + (sunlight * 1.16)) + (sky_fill * 0.17)) * material_light
            set ground_red to ground_red * lighting + sunlight * 0.13
            set ground_green to ground_green * lighting + sunlight * 0.10
            set ground_blue to ground_blue * lighting + sunlight * 0.070

            set fog to smooth transition from 188.0 to 376.0 at ray_distance
            set fog_red to 0.17 + sun_halo * 0.17
            set fog_green to 0.23 + sun_halo * 0.105
            set fog_blue to 0.31 + sun_halo * 0.052
            set red to ground_red * (1.0 - fog) + fog_red * fog
            set green to ground_green * (1.0 - fog) + fog_green * fog
            set blue to ground_blue * (1.0 - fog) + fog_blue * fog

    set vignette_radius to the square root of ((screen_x / aspect) * (screen_x / aspect) + screen_y * screen_y)
    set vignette to 0.38 + (1.0 - smooth transition from 0.58 to 1.34 at vignette_radius) * 0.62
    set red to the square root of ((red * vignette) / (1.0 + red * 0.38))
    set green to the square root of ((green * vignette) / (1.0 + green * 0.38))
    set blue to the square root of ((blue * vignette) / (1.0 + blue * 0.38))
    set the fragment color to red green blue 1.0

scenes.title: Nano Choreography
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# NANO CHOREOGRAPHY
# One persistent point population forms a racing motorcycle, flies through
# three-dimensional space, and lands on a model-derived Vitruvian figure.

function scene window from opening to closing at moment:
    execute:
        set arrival to smooth transition from opening to (opening + 0.55) at moment
        set departure to 1.0 - smooth transition from (closing - 0.55) to closing at moment
        return arrival * departure

if this is a vertex shader:
    # Each input axis packs one motorcycle source and one Vitruvian target.
    set packed_x to the vertex x
    set packed_y to the vertex y
    set packed_z to the vertex z
    set encoded_triangle_corner to the vertex w
    set wheel_point to the floor of (encoded_triangle_corner / 4.0)
    set triangle_corner to encoded_triangle_corner - (wheel_point * 4.0)
    set target_quantized_x to the floor of (packed_x / 4096.0)
    set target_quantized_y to the floor of (packed_y / 4096.0)
    set target_quantized_z to the floor of (packed_z / 4096.0)
    set motorcycle_quantized_x to packed_x - (target_quantized_x * 4096.0)
    set motorcycle_quantized_y to packed_y - (target_quantized_y * 4096.0)
    set motorcycle_quantized_z to packed_z - (target_quantized_z * 4096.0)
    set point_x to ((target_quantized_x / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0
    set point_y to ((target_quantized_y / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0
    set point_z to ((target_quantized_z / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0
    set motorcycle_local_x to ((motorcycle_quantized_x / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0
    set motorcycle_local_y to ((motorcycle_quantized_y / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0
    set motorcycle_local_z to ((motorcycle_quantized_z / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0

    set time to the shader time
    set width to the maximum of the shader width and 1.0
    set height to the maximum of the shader height and 1.0
    set render_pass to the shader render pass
    set aspect to width / height
    set viewport_horizontal_scale to 1.0 / aspect
    set moment to the minimum of time and 10.40
    set visibility to scene window from 0.0 to 11.0 at moment

    # Wheel-tagged points rotate around their generated local hubs.
    set motorcycle_wheel_spin to (0.0 - time) * 9.4
    set wheel_spin_sine to the sine of motorcycle_wheel_spin
    set wheel_spin_cosine to the cosine of motorcycle_wheel_spin
    set wheel_center_x to -0.72
    if motorcycle_local_x > 0.0:
        set wheel_center_x to 0.72
    set wheel_offset_x to motorcycle_local_x - wheel_center_x
    set wheel_offset_y to motorcycle_local_y + 0.42
    set wheel_rotated_x to (wheel_offset_x * wheel_spin_cosine) - (wheel_offset_y * wheel_spin_sine)
    set wheel_rotated_y to (wheel_offset_x * wheel_spin_sine) + (wheel_offset_y * wheel_spin_cosine)
    if wheel_point > 0.5:
        set motorcycle_local_x to wheel_center_x + wheel_rotated_x
        set motorcycle_local_y to -0.42 + wheel_rotated_y

    # The point-built motorcycle races front-first toward the perspective camera.
    set motorcycle_progress to smooth transition from 0.0 to 4.25 at moment
    set motorcycle_yaw to 1.30 + (motorcycle_progress * 0.04)
    set motorcycle_yaw_sine to the sine of motorcycle_yaw
    set motorcycle_yaw_cosine to the cosine of motorcycle_yaw
    set motorcycle_turned_x to (motorcycle_local_x * motorcycle_yaw_cosine) + (motorcycle_local_z * motorcycle_yaw_sine)
    set motorcycle_turned_z to (motorcycle_local_z * motorcycle_yaw_cosine) - (motorcycle_local_x * motorcycle_yaw_sine)
    set motorcycle_world_x to motorcycle_turned_x + ((0.0 - 1.26) + (motorcycle_progress * 1.18))
    set motorcycle_world_y to motorcycle_local_y + ((0.0 - 0.19) + (motorcycle_progress * 0.12))
    set motorcycle_world_z to motorcycle_turned_z + (2.80 - (motorcycle_progress * 4.90))
    set motorcycle_depth to the maximum of (motorcycle_world_z + 4.2) and 0.20
    set motorcycle_ndc_x to ((motorcycle_world_x * 1.72) * viewport_horizontal_scale) / motorcycle_depth
    set motorcycle_ndc_y to (motorcycle_world_y * 1.72) / motorcycle_depth

    # The model target keeps its centered, slowly rotating volumetric projection.
    set target_yaw to (the sine of (time * 0.31)) * 0.34
    set target_yaw_sine to the sine of target_yaw
    set target_yaw_cosine to the cosine of target_yaw
    set target_turned_x to (point_x * target_yaw_cosine) + (point_z * target_yaw_sine)
    set target_turned_z to (point_z * target_yaw_cosine) - (point_x * target_yaw_sine)
    set target_depth to 3.25 + (target_turned_z * 0.52)
    set target_ndc_x to ((target_turned_x * 1.66) * viewport_horizontal_scale) / target_depth
    set target_ndc_y to ((point_y * 1.86) - 0.04) / target_depth

    # Continuous flock fields make neighboring drones leave and land together.
    set drone_seed_a to ((the sine of (((point_x * 3.13) + (point_y * 2.71)) + (point_z * 4.19))) * 0.5) + 0.5
    set drone_seed_b to ((the sine of (((point_x * -2.17) + (point_y * 3.91)) + (point_z * 2.43))) * 0.5) + 0.5
    set drone_delay to drone_seed_a * 0.75
    set assembly_progress to smooth transition from (4.45 + drone_delay) to (6.65 + drone_delay) at moment
    set flight_arc to (the sine of (assembly_progress * 3.14159265)) * (0.10 + (drone_seed_b * 0.24))
    set flight_phase to (drone_seed_b * 6.28318531) + (assembly_progress * 3.2)
    set flight_sweep to (the sine of (assembly_progress * 3.14159265)) * 0.12
    set flight_x to (((the cosine of flight_phase) * flight_arc) + flight_sweep) * viewport_horizontal_scale
    set flight_y to (the sine of flight_phase) * flight_arc * 0.72
    set assembled_ndc_x to motorcycle_ndc_x + (target_ndc_x - motorcycle_ndc_x) * assembly_progress + flight_x
    set assembled_ndc_y to motorcycle_ndc_y + (target_ndc_y - motorcycle_ndc_y) * assembly_progress + flight_y
    set depth to motorcycle_depth + ((target_depth - motorcycle_depth) * assembly_progress)

    set relative_point_size to 0.00104 * (0.96 + render_pass * 0.04)
    set point_size_x to relative_point_size * viewport_horizontal_scale
    set point_size_y to relative_point_size
    set corner_x to 0.0 - point_size_x
    set corner_y to 0.0 - point_size_y
    if triangle_corner >= 1.0:
        set corner_x to point_size_x
    if triangle_corner >= 2.0:
        set corner_x to 0.0
        set corner_y to point_size_y * 1.45
    set clip_x to (assembled_ndc_x + corner_x) * depth
    set clip_y to (assembled_ndc_y + corner_y) * depth
    if visibility < 0.001:
        set clip_x to depth * 3.0
    set the output position to clip_x clip_y (depth * 0.42) depth
else:
    set pixel_x to the fragment x coordinate
    set pixel_y to the fragment y coordinate
    set time to the shader time
    set width to the maximum of the shader width and 1.0
    set height to the maximum of the shader height and 1.0
    set render_pass to the shader render pass
    set aspect to width / height
    set screen_x to ((((pixel_x / width) * 2.0) - 1.0) * aspect)
    set screen_y to (((pixel_y / height) * 2.0) - 1.0)
    set radial to the square root of ((screen_x * screen_x) + (screen_y * screen_y))
    set moment to the minimum of time and 10.40

    if render_pass > 0.5:
        set point_wave to ((the sine of (((screen_x * 19.0) - (screen_y * 13.0)) + (time * 4.2))) * 0.5) + 0.5
        set scan_wave to ((the sine of ((screen_y * 47.0) - (time * 6.8))) * 0.5) + 0.5
        set motorcycle_color to 1.0 - (smooth transition from 4.45 to 7.40 at moment)
        set point_red to 0.08 + (point_wave * 0.28) + (motorcycle_color * 0.38)
        set point_green to 0.30 + (scan_wave * 0.24) + (motorcycle_color * 0.12)
        set point_blue to 0.66 + (point_wave * 0.30) - (motorcycle_color * 0.18)
        set the fragment color to point_red point_green point_blue 1.0
    else:
        set speed_visibility to scene window from 0.0 to 7.40 at moment
        set vitruvian_visibility to scene window from 6.85 to 11.0 at moment

        # Continuous fields form a deep chamber and a wake around the point vehicle.
        set chamber_one to flowing field at (screen_x * 2.2 + time * 0.021) (screen_y * 2.2 - time * 0.014) 1.9
        set chamber_two to ridged field at (screen_x * 4.1 - time * 0.017) (screen_y * 4.1 + time * 0.011) 5.4
        set free_drones to spark field at (screen_x * 27.0 + time * 0.24) (screen_y * 27.0 - time * 0.13) 9.7
        set speed_particles to spark field at (screen_x * 7.0 + time * 8.4) (screen_y * 46.0) 14.2
        set speed_core to glow from 0.0 to 0.66 at (the absolute value of screen_y)
        set speed_trails to (speed_particles * speed_core) * speed_visibility
        set red to (((0.003 + (chamber_one * 0.012)) + (chamber_two * 0.018)) + (free_drones * 0.18)) + (speed_trails * 0.32)
        set green to (((0.006 + (chamber_one * 0.024)) + (chamber_two * 0.015)) + (free_drones * 0.46)) + (speed_trails * 0.78)
        set blue to (((0.024 + (chamber_one * 0.082)) + (chamber_two * 0.071)) + (free_drones * 1.02)) + (speed_trails * 1.46)
        set figure_aura to glow from 0.28 to 1.26 at radial
        set red to red + ((figure_aura * vitruvian_visibility) * 0.032)
        set green to green + ((figure_aura * vitruvian_visibility) * 0.095)
        set blue to blue + ((figure_aura * vitruvian_visibility) * 0.21)

        # A projected radius sweeps around the model's own rotating circle.
        set measurement_visibility to smooth transition from 7.55 to 8.10 at moment
        set measurement_angle to (time - 7.55) * 1.32
        set measurement_radius to 1.08
        set circle_source_x to (the cosine of measurement_angle) * measurement_radius
        set circle_source_y to (the sine of measurement_angle) * measurement_radius
        set measurement_yaw to (the sine of (time * 0.31)) * 0.34
        set circle_turned_x to circle_source_x * (the cosine of measurement_yaw)
        set circle_turned_z to 0.0 - (circle_source_x * (the sine of measurement_yaw))
        set circle_depth to 3.25 + (circle_turned_z * 0.52)
        set radius_center_y to (0.0 - 0.04) / 3.25
        set radius_end_x to circle_turned_x * 1.66 / circle_depth
        set radius_end_y to ((circle_source_y * 1.86) - 0.04) / circle_depth
        set radius_distance to distance from point screen_x screen_y to segment 0.0 radius_center_y radius_end_x radius_end_y
        set radius_line to glow from 0.002 to 0.009 at radius_distance
        set radius_vector_x to radius_end_x
        set radius_vector_y to radius_end_y - radius_center_y
        set radius_length to the maximum of (the square root of ((radius_vector_x * radius_vector_x) + (radius_vector_y * radius_vector_y))) and 0.0001
        set tangent_x to (0.0 - radius_vector_y) / radius_length
        set tangent_y to radius_vector_x / radius_length
        set tick_start_x to radius_end_x - (tangent_x * 0.026)
        set tick_start_y to radius_end_y - (tangent_y * 0.026)
        set tick_end_x to radius_end_x + (tangent_x * 0.026)
        set tick_end_y to radius_end_y + (tangent_y * 0.026)
        set radius_tick_distance to distance from point screen_x screen_y to segment tick_start_x tick_start_y tick_end_x tick_end_y
        set radius_tick to glow from 0.002 to 0.011 at radius_tick_distance
        set highlight_x to screen_x - radius_end_x
        set highlight_y to screen_y - radius_end_y
        set highlight_distance to the square root of ((highlight_x * highlight_x) + (highlight_y * highlight_y))
        set circle_highlight to glow from 0.0 to 0.045 at highlight_distance
        set center_distance to the square root of ((screen_x * screen_x) + ((screen_y - radius_center_y) * (screen_y - radius_center_y)))
        set center_highlight to glow from 0.0 to 0.025 at center_distance
        set measurement_light to (((radius_line * 0.62) + (radius_tick * 0.82)) + (circle_highlight * 0.48)) + (center_highlight * 0.36)
        set measurement_light to measurement_light * measurement_visibility
        set red to red + (measurement_light * 0.46)
        set green to green + (measurement_light * 0.88)
        set blue to blue + (measurement_light * 1.24)

        set vignette to 0.18 + ((1.0 - (smooth transition from 0.52 to 1.62 at radial)) * 0.82)
        set red to the square root of ((red * vignette) / (1.0 + red))
        set green to the square root of ((green * vignette) / (1.0 + green))
        set blue to the square root of ((blue * vignette) / (1.0 + blue))
        set the fragment color to red green blue 1.0

modifications: Centered and uniformly scaled from the pinned STL.
Converted to deterministic surface and inward-density points.
Paired spatially neighboring target and motorcycle regions recursively.
Tagged motorcycle wheel points for vertex-stage rotation.
Expanded into micro-triangles for the DynLex WebGL renderer.
